question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together
Great accomplishment is the described attainment
Such attainment brings favor of yoginīs
inference: One who attains enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
